title_as_printed: Experimental heat capacities of aqueous Na2SO4 solutions at P = 200 bars.

footnotes_as_printed.a: Densities of Na2SO4 solutions at 25 C and 200 bars.
footnotes_as_printed.b: The estimated uncertainty of each phi_Cp value was calculated assuming absolute errors of +-0.00015 in P_s/P_w and relative errors of +-1% in (P_s-P_w)/P_w and in the correction factor, f.

footnote_letter_note: Footnote a belongs to header rho_s, footnote b to header Unc; stripped from the header names, the note column is empty because no letters are attached to numbers
pressure_note: 200 bar (constant, in title), flowing-calorimeter pressure; not a saturation pressure

value.what: apparent molar heat capacity of Na2SO4 at 200 bar, per mole of Na2SO4

value2.what: specific heat capacity of the solution (measured via power ratio)

uncertainty.what: estimated uncertainty of each phi_Cp, footnote b

composition.other_species: none (m header has no unit printed; text speaks of molality, so mol per kg water assumed from the text)

skip_rows.reason: temperature label rows 'T(K) = ..., f = ...' (f = heat-loss correction factor)

extra_unmapped: rho_s g.cm-3 (density of the solution at 25 C and 200 bar, taken from literature (Chen 1977, Gibson 1934) not measured here)
P_s/P_w (ratio of electrical powers solution/water, raw measured quantity)
f (heat-loss correction factor printed in label row)
notes: Replicate measurements at the same molality are separate printed rows and are kept. Water properties from Haar et al. (1984) equation of state.
